quote.text:
Building games used to be why kids learned to code.

Teaching a robot toy might be how they learn AI.

Explored Microduck with my daughter, and simulated the duck to draw/trace with its feet.

She drew the shapes. Opus stood up the sim, helped define rewards, and fielded her infinite questions. The duck already has a trained walking policy. We gave it the outlines, and used rewards to tune its steering over 96 simulated attempts.

Next time the activity is her choosing the reward and watching the curve move.
